analyst_view.overall: Early view: fourth-placed Betis host promoted Racing (10th), who came from behind to win at Málaga in their last game. Betis host Como in the Champions League on the Wednesday before, so rotation is possible. Cucho Hernández (Betis) and Andrés Martín (Racing) should be back from injury by then; Racing's Álvaro Mantilla is out for the season.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals, which is high. I lean lower: Betis may rotate after the Como game four days earlier, and Racing have shown they can stay in games, including a comeback win away at Málaga.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.5 corners. Betis' wide play (Ezzalzouli and Antony in the probable line-ups) supports a high count, so I stay with the model.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards. No referee yet and no rivalry; Racing's 3.0 expected cards already reflects a side defending a lot away from home.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.7 shots. I lean slightly lower for the same reason as goals: a possible rotated Betis after the Champions League may not keep up a 20-shot pace.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.9 shots on target. Nothing specific moves this beyond the rotation risk already reflected in shots.
